summary: Frontend-only verification of Supabase Google OAuth initiation and welcome/login screens on the Roomie Expo web preview. Welcome screen renders all three expected testIDs (welcome-get-started, welcome-google, welcome-login). Tapping 'Continue with Google' correctly invokes supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({provider:'google', skipBrowserRedirect:true}) and sets window.location.href to the returned authorize URL, which 302-redirects the browser all the way to accounts.google.com (page title 'Sign in - Google Accounts') with the correct client_id and redirect_uri=https://qgenemhetpmfunphlrbe.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback. 'I already have an account' routes to /login which renders Email/Password inputs and a Sign in button (testIDs: login-email, login-password, login-submit). No 'provider not enabled' or 'Unsupported provider' error. Google OAuth flow is correctly wired end-to-end on web.
critical_code_review_comments: welcome.tsx and supabase.ts implementation looks correct: PKCE flow, detectSessionInUrl on web, skipBrowserRedirect:true so the app controls the navigation via window.location.href on web. Native path uses WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync + exchangeCodeForSession – not covered by this web test but code is consistent with Supabase PKCE guidance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL used: https://app-in-progress-19.preview.emergentagent.com (from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — this differs from the host mentioned in the review_request, but it is the live served host). Supabase project qgenemhetpmfunphlrbe has Google provider ENABLED with client_id 348788962911-ft9esdrqdk29n62qbdhhvjc0ndqm7jmi.apps.googleusercontent.com. Email/password login was intentionally NOT tested beyond rendering (user has 'email_not_confirmed' until confirmation is disabled in Supabase).
